summary: Implementation depends on a supported Blacksmith capability binding each Testbox request to its workflow run before worker registration, including admission failure and cancellation. The supplied triage explicitly awaits that capability; current main contains no integration for it. Keep the issue open pending that provider contract. No code changed or PR proposed.

actions.reason: Keep the issue open pending a supported, durable Testbox-to-workflow binding and terminal-status contract. No narrow adapter patch can currently distinguish slow allocation from pre-worker dispatch failure without inventing an unsupported association, so an executable fix artifact cannot safely be supplied.
